name: question-generator
description: AI問題生成タスク - TOEFL/IELTS問題を生成してアプリのRoom DB (SQLite) に積み立てる

scripts.generate:vocab: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type vocabulary
scripts.generate:grammar: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type grammar
scripts.generate:reading: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type reading
scripts.generate:listening: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type listening
scripts.generate:speaking: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type speaking
scripts.generate:writing: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type writing
scripts.generate:tutor: npm run build && node dist/index.js --type tutor
scripts.pull-db: adb exec-out run-as com.gachiguild.gachitoefl cat databases/ai_toefl_coach.db > ./db/device_ai_toefl_coach.db
scripts.push-db: adb shell "run-as com.gachiguild.gachitoefl sh -c 'rm -f databases/ai_toefl_coach.db databases/ai_toefl_coach.db-wal databases/ai_toefl_coach.db-shm && cat > databases/ai_toefl_coach.db && chmod 660 databases/ai_toefl_coach.db'" < ./db/device_ai_toefl_coach.db
